rationale: Block 3 introduces the WHO definition of essential medicines and the selection criteria; a recall-level MC question tests retention of the core WHO definition, which is high-yield for examinations and daily PHC prescribing.

Block 7 defines substandard, falsified, and counterfeit medicines and distinguishes them. This TrueFalse item tests a commonly confused distinction — whether 'substandard' and 'falsified' are synonyms — directly grounded in WHO definitions.

Block 11 covers operational application of the EML framework at the PHC level, including indent based on morbidity data and rational prescribing. An Apply-level question presents a realistic PHC scenario and asks the learner to select the correct rational-use action, directly mapping to CM19.4 (applying EML principles in practice).
